verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only generic marketing about data that 'keeps everything in sync', 'live' data, and agents that 'monitor your source data 24/7'. Nothing shows a per-source last-synced indicator or a documented refresh schedule tied to the close. These vague sync claims do not establish the story's actual capability.

support.subject: As a finance lead, each connected source shows when it last synced, and data refreshes on a documented schedule after the close
